name: Expert_ABC_WS_MFI
summary: This EA uses the MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator smoothed by a Moving Average as a momentum signal filter within the MetaQuotes standard Expert Advisor framework. It opens and closes positions based on threshold-based signal logic from the CBC_WS_MFI filter, with fixed lot sizing and no trailing stop. The strategy relies on the weighted MFI signal crossing configurable open/close thresholds to generate trade decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MFI（市场促进指数）指标经移动平均平滑后作为动量信号过滤器，在MetaQuotes标准专家顾问框架内运行。它基于CBC_WS_MFI过滤器的阈值信号逻辑来开仓和平仓，采用固定手数且无追踪止损。策略依赖加权MFI信号穿越可配置的开仓/平仓阈值来生成交易决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于MFI（市场促进指数）指标与移动平均线的组合，属于动量类交易策略。入场条件由CBC_WS_MFI过滤器生成信号值，当信号值超过开仓阈值（默认10）时开仓，超过平仓阈值时平仓。MFI指标周期设为37，MA平滑周期设为13，权重为1.0，表明该过滤器是唯一的信号来源且完全控制交易方向。出场条件依赖于信号阈值反向穿越以及固定的止损（50点）和止盈（50点）设置。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（CMoneyFixedLot），默认手数为0.1，资金百分比为10%，不进行动态仓位调整。资金管理较为简单，缺乏根据账户余额或波动性自适应调整仓位的机制。挂单有效期为4根K线，策略不使用追踪止损，意味着盈利后无法锁定浮动利润。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the combination of the MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator with a Moving Average smoother, classifying it as a momentum-type trading strategy. Entry conditions are generated by the CBC_WS_MFI filter, which produces a signal value that triggers a trade when it exceeds the open threshold (default 10) and closes when it exceeds the close threshold. The MFI indicator period is set to 37, the MA smoothing period is 13, and the weight is 1.0, indicating this filter is the sole signal source with full control over trade direction. Exit conditions rely on the signal threshold being crossed in the opposite direction along with fixed stop loss (50 points) and take profit (50 points) levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (CMoneyFixedLot) with a default lot size of 0.1 and a money percentage of 10%, with no dynamic position adjustment. Money management is simplistic, lacking any mechanism to adapt lot size based on account balance or market volatility. Pending orders expire after 4 bars, and the strategy uses no trailing stop, meaning floating profits cannot be locked in after favorable price movement.

pros: 使用MetaQuotes标准专家顾问框架，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
MFI指标经MA平滑后可减少虚假信号，提高信号质量
固定止损止盈设置提供了基本的风险控制框架
采用信号阈值机制而非简单方向判断，允许灵活调整开平仓灵敏度
pros_en: Uses the MetaQuotes standard Expert Advisor framework with clean, well-structured code that is easy to maintain and extend
MFI indicator smoothed by MA reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Fixed stop loss and take profit settings provide a basic risk control framework
Signal threshold mechanism allows flexible adjustment of entry/exit sensitivity rather than simple directional judgment
cons: 无追踪止损，盈利交易无法锁定浮动利润，可能面临大幅回撤
固定手数模式缺乏自适应仓位管理，无法根据市场波动性或账户余额动态调整
止损止盈均为50点且对称设置，未考虑MFI指标本身的波动特征和市场环境
仅依赖单一MFI过滤器，缺乏多信号确认机制，容易产生错误信号
cons_en: No trailing stop means profitable trades cannot lock in floating profits, potentially facing significant drawdowns
Fixed lot sizing lacks adaptive position management, unable to dynamically adjust based on market volatility or account balance
Symmetric 50-point stop loss and take profit do not account for MFI indicator volatility characteristics or market conditions
Relies solely on a single MFI filter with no multi-signal confirmation mechanism, making it prone to false signals
improvements: 增加追踪止损功能，在盈利达到一定点数后自动移动止损以保护利润
引入基于ATR的动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整风险参数
improvements_en: Add trailing stop functionality to automatically move the stop loss after reaching a certain profit threshold to protect gains
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adaptively adjust risk parameters based on market volatility

risk_points: 无追踪止损导致盈利交易可能转为亏损，风险控制不够完善
固定止损50点在低波动市场中可能过大，在高波动市场中可能过小，缺乏适应性
单一信号源无多重确认，存在错误开仓的风险
risk_points_en: No trailing stop means winning trades can turn into losses, indicating incomplete risk control
Fixed 50-point stop loss may be too wide in low-volatility markets and too narrow in high-volatility markets, lacking adaptability
Single signal source without multi-confirmation carries risk of incorrect entries
